resources.string: Cloud sync: sign in to keep your solves and sessions on every device, and resolve sync conflicts from the sync dialog.
Account tools: email verification and password reset links, change password and delete account, all in the app.
Optional WCA inspection with a 15-second countdown and automatic +2 / DNF.
Start delay from 0 to 500 ms, so a tap can start the timer right away.
Settings redesigned in Material 3 Expressive style, with an About section.
Polish translation. Pick the language in your system\'s per-app language settings.
CSV export and import now carry the timing device and guard against spreadsheet formula injection.
